name: Ente Photos
tagline: A consolation build is possible, but the paid product's decisive value sits outside a solo rebuild. For Ente Photos, host an end-to-end encrypted photo backup on user-owned infrastructure. The hard boundary is audited encryption, cross-platform clients, background backup, sharing, and recovery, plus image pipeline quality, models, and workflow polish.
